newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 2.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 2.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Over three billion forints of unjustifiable agricultural export subsidies have been granted over the last years.
- Lack of funds prevents closer scrutiny of family subsidies.
- Companies protest again government plans to only allow easier temporary work adiminstration for private individuals.
- Privatisation agency APV Rt expects 1.3 billion forints income from the third and final wave of simplified privatisation.
